text: まけると　わかってて　たたかうか！

structure.jp: まけると　わかってて

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: まけると　わかってて
patterns.explanation: と after a plain sentence says what is known or thought. まけるとわかってて = 'knowing that you'll lose'.

patterns.name: 〜か
patterns.explanation: か at the end of a rough sentence makes a challenging or disbelieving question. たたかうか = 'you'd actually fight?!'.
